titles.title: Ensuring Kids Have Access to Medically Necessary Dental Care Act
Ensuring Kids Have Access to Medically Necessary Dental Care Act

A bill to amend title XXI of the Social Security Act to prohibit lifetime or annual limits on dental coverage under the Children's Health Insurance Program, and to require wraparound coverage of dental services for certain children under such program.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.
